svg.text: GPipe: all forwards, then all backwards
Activations for every microbatch stay resident until its backward pass. Memory grows with the number of microbatches.
1F1B: one forward, one backward after warm-up
Each stage holds at most K microbatches of activations. The bubble is the same size, but memory is bounded by pipeline depth.
4 stages, 4 microbatches, equal F and B cost
